text:
rachel.t: Quick note - I have a progressive hearing loss diagnosis and wanted to request accommodations for meetings. Live captions for video calls and a meeting mic in conference rooms would help a lot. Also prefer written summaries after standups.

geoff.m: Thanks for telling us, Rachel. Totally happy to support. Can you share what level of captioning you need (auto-captions ok or human/live stenographer)? Also will this change your ability to join meetings at current times?

rachel.t: Auto captions are helpful but error-prone; for larger cross-team meetings I'd really appreciate human-assisted captions or a live transcript. Async alternatives are fine for status updates. I can attend all meetings but may need to sit near the room mic on-site.

lena.hr: This is an accommodation request. If you're comfortable, please submit the ADA intake form so we have official documentation; we can start interim measures immediately while intake is pending.

marco.a: IT can enable live captions (third-party service) for company calls and order a conference room mic for recurring rooms. For human-assisted captions we may need vendor scheduling for big all-hands. Do you have a list of recurring meetings where captions are critical?

rachel.t: Thanks Marco. Critical ones: weekly all-hands, eng-planning, and cross-functional product syncs. Standups can be covered by written notes.

geoff.m: I'll mark those as high priority. For on-site, Rachel, we'll reserve a seat near the mic and remind folks to use the room mic. For async, I'll ask leads to post short written summaries after standups.

lena.hr: Interim plan: 1) enable auto captions for Rachel's recurring meetings, 2) order room mic for 2 main conference rooms within 10 business days, 3) request vendor human captions for monthly all-hands, 4) manager to provide written standup note protocol, 5) 14-day check-in. Case opened in HR tracker.

it-ops-bot: Ticket IT-4599 created: "conference room mic + captions enablement (Rachel T)".

marco.a: I'll enable captions for Rachel's calendar and schedule a trial with the vendor for the next all-hands. If human captions approved, we'll arrange billing with People Ops.

rachel.t: Appreciate it — that will make meetings so much easier. I'll submit the intake tonight and attach a brief audiology note when I can.

lena.hr: Thank you, Rachel. Confidentiality reminder: accommodation details will only be shared with people who need to know (manager, IT, facilities). I'll post the interim accommodation doc here when ready for signatures.

geoff.m: Team, please pause any assumptions about meeting format changes until the plan is posted. We'll aim to be flexible and keep delivery on track.

marco.a: Captioning enabled for the listed recurrences. Vendor trial booked for next all-hands.

rachel.t: Signed the interim plan. Thank you everyone. :pray:
